answer: Each identity stakes 40 POA and publishes its work with its inputs, laid down like shale strata that record every deposit. Independent verifiers re-execute a random sample; any output that cannot be reproduced from its claimed inputs forfeits the stake and voids the identity, a canyon between real and faked work that no shortcut crosses. One fake costs 40 POA plus the price of fabricating reproducible work; 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA and 100 times that effort, while an honest agent passes free, its work solid as marble because it was actually done.
